explanation: SIMULATED PLACEHOLDER: the sample imagines road closures near the Yamuna and an assumed power dependency at an LNJP Hospital service node. GTB Hospital remains a destination in the story. These are hard-coded UI examples, not observed failures or computed forecasts.
bottlenecks: Two synthetic road closures constrain cross-area access.
The LNJP service node has a fictional backup-power limit.

interventions.rationale: Illustrate temporary backup power at the LNJP service node.
Illustrate pre-positioning vehicles near the GTB service node.
Illustrate additional synthetic shelter capacity on the east bank.

assumptions: All coordinates, capacities, node IDs, backup durations and metrics are simulated placeholders, even when real hospital names are used.
Timeline hours are illustrative; no temporal model has run.
Intervention comparisons are hand-authored UI fixtures, not calculated benefits.
Each comparison evaluates one intervention against the same baseline; benefits are not additive.
confidence_notes: No verified Delhi facility data has been loaded.
